name: aws_lakeformation_resource
description: Registers an Amazon S3 path as a data lake resource with AWS Lake Formation, enabling fine-grained access control for data lake permissions.

arn.name: arn
arn.description: Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource, an S3 path.

role_arn.name: role_arn
role_arn.description: Role that has read/write access to the resource. Required for hybrid access mode.

use_service_linked_role.name: use_service_linked_role
use_service_linked_role.description: Designates an IAM service-linked role as a Lake Formation data access role.

hybrid_access_enabled.name: hybrid_access_enabled
hybrid_access_enabled.description: Flag to enable Lake Formation hybrid access mode on the registered resource.
